wedo_instance.title: Integration Plan: Wallet-Gated Access for Metagit-Feed
wedo_instance.description: Utilizing the PrecisionBOM WalletConnect and Gatekeeper API from the Part-Sourcing-Hackathon repository to provide secure, subscription-based access to the Metagit-Feed replay substrate.

meta.philosophy: Sovereignty is verified at the edge through cryptographic signatures and on-chain registries.
meta.relay_note: New mission instantiated by Cleanthes to bridge the Hackathon's authentication layer with the Feed's replay cortex.

rules.total_ingestion: MANDATE: Ingest the source WalletConnect.tsx and gatekeeper/route.ts before Turn 1 of implementation.
rules.turn_by_turn_commit: MANDATE: Commit each modular integration (Component, API, Layout) independently via 'metagit_commit.py'.
rules.direct_aesthetic: MANDATE: All implementation reports must be shared 'straightup' in the chat.

tasks.description: Extract 'WalletConnect.tsx' and associated UI components from 'part-sourcing-hackathon/nextjs-app/components/' to 'metagit-feed/components/'.
Port the 'gatekeeper' API route from the hackathon to 'metagit-feed/app/api/gatekeeper/route.ts', ensuring environment variables (SEPOLIA_RPC_URL, PRIVATE_KEY) are configured.
Modify 'metagit-feed/app/layout.tsx' to wrap the application in an Auth Guard that requires a valid 'forensic_identity' in localStorage.
Integrate the 'WalletConnect' component into the Metagit-Feed sidebar or header for real-time identity management.
Update 'metagit-feed/app/api/forensics/route.ts' (if it exists) to verify the session signature against the Gatekeeper registry before serving logs.
Test the end-to-end 'Connect -> Sign -> Pay -> Access' flow on Sepolia testnet.
